name_reason: Convention-compliant: data_fd2_battle_ prefix (battle core pathfind table region), descriptor pathfind_floodfill_max_steps reflects both domain (pathfind/floodfill) and semantic role (the max_steps movement-step budget, a scalar counter). No Ghidra address residue (no _70 / hex tail). Matches the contiguous seed-block sibling naming (floodfill_seed_x / floodfill_seed_y / floodfill_max_steps).
purpose: Flood-fill / pathfind movement step budget (max_steps): the initial residual movement cost both pathfind orchestrators write into the origin tile's marker so the recursive expansion can decrement it outward.
logic_summary: Last field of the contiguous seed block seed_x(0x6006E)/seed_y(0x6006F)/max_steps(0x60070). Both orchestrators (fd2_init_movement_range_floodfill @0x4E040, fd2_pathfind_to_destination @0x4E1A6) write it at entry from their step-budget arg truncated to the low byte (WRITE 0x4E060 / 0x4E1C6), then read it back 8-bit (READ 0x4E0C6 / 0x4E24C) and store it into the origin tile marker tile_map[(map_width*seed_y+seed_x)*4+7], giving the recursion a full budget to decrement during 4-neighbour expansion.
element_semantics: Single scalar (not an array): unsigned movement-step budget for the current flood-fill / pathfind run; used as the origin tile's starting (highest) residual cost.
comment_original_issue: src comment block (pathfnd.c lines 842-854) was already accurate, precise, and ASCII -> kept. Ghidra side had two defects (fixed via plate): the data plate was in the wrong comment field (PRE_COMMENT, PLATE_COMMENT was null) contrary to project data-plate convention, contained non-ASCII chars (em-dash, <=), and carried a stale 'emit_action = emit_c_const' tag even though the global is written by the game (non-const, emitted as zero-init BSS).
notes: Verified via Ghidra: datatype=byte, exactly 4 xrefs (2 WRITE 0x4E060/0x4E1C6, 2 READ 0x4E0C6/0x4E24C), memory all zero at load (BSS). Both decompiled users (fd2_init_movement_range_floodfill, fd2_pathfind_to_destination) confirm write-then-read-back-into-origin-marker access. Game writes it -> non-const. Ghidra plate rewritten into PLATE_COMMENT (ASCII, src-consistent), stale PRE_COMMENT cleared, save_program succeeded. No src edit needed for this symbol (comment already correct).
